1-s79.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 1, с. 79. 1–2) Прослушай, что есть в деревне Покахонтас и какую конструкцию она использует; 3) скажи, сколько предметов и животных в деревне.
steps: 1) There is a river in my village. There are wigwams in my village.
2) Конструкция there is / there are.
3) There is 1 turkey. There are 7 wigwams. There is 1 rabbit. There are 3 bows and 9 arrows. There are 4 boats. There are 3 birds.
1-s79.answer: there is — ед. ч., there are — мн. ч.; 1 turkey, 7 wigwams, 1 rabbit, 3 bows, 9 arrows, 4 boats, 3 birds

2-s80.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 2, с. 80. Скажи, сколько животных пришло в гости к Покахонтас.
steps: There is 1 bear. There is 1 owl. There are 2 foxes. There are 5 rabbits. There are 3 raccoons. There are 4 birds.
2-s80.answer: 1 bear, 1 owl, 2 foxes, 5 rabbits, 3 raccoons, 4 birds

3-s80.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 3, с. 80. 1) Опиши Лондон; 2) чем Лондон отличается от деревни; 3) почему Покахонтас хочет увидеть Лондон.
steps: 1) There are bridges in London. There are houses in London. There are streets in London.
2) There are no bridges, no streets and no big houses in her village.
3) There are big houses, streets and bridges in London. There are wigwams and animals in her village, but there are no streets or bridges there.
3-s80.answer: London — bridges, streets, big houses; village — wigwams, animals, no bridges

4-s81.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 4, с. 81. Напиши, что есть в твоей деревне.
steps: There is a river in my village. There are wigwams in my village. There are boats. There are wolves and foxes. There are fish in the river.
4-s81.answer: There is a … There are … in my village.

1-s82.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 1, с. 82. 1) Как представляется злая ведьма; 2) заполни пропуски, чтобы узнать, какая она на самом деле.
steps: 1) I am a princess. I am kind and nice. My friends are dwarfs. They are merry and friendly. We like singing and dancing.
2) She is not a princess. She is a witch. Her friends are not dwarfs. They are not friendly. They like playing tricks.
1-s82.answer: is not, is, are, are not, like

2-s83.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 2, с. 83. 1) Какого персонажа выбрал мальчик для карнавала; 2) вставь слова в текст.
steps: 1) Winnie-the-Pooh.
2) is, he, likes, are, like.
2-s83.answer: Winnie-the-Pooh; is, he, likes, are, like

3-s83.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 3, с. 83. Опиши героев сказки словами из упражнения.
steps: I am a mascot. I am merry, friendly and funny. I am not evil. I like playing football and tennis. I am good at swimming.
I am an Indian girl. I am kind, friendly and brave. I am not silly. I like singing, dancing and swimming.
She is a mermaid. She is nice and joyful. She likes singing.
3-s83.answer: I am … I am not … I like … I am good at …

4-s84.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 4, с. 84. Игра: составь предложения о себе по опорным фразам.
steps: I am a mouse. I am funny and little. I'm not brave. I like cheese. My friends are birds. They are kind. We like singing together.
4-s84.answer: I am … I like … My friends are … We like …

5-s84.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 5, с. 84. 1) Составь стихотворение; 2) подбери по два слова из рамки к каждому слову.
steps: 1) A pig is big. A cat is black. A puppy is funny. A hen is red. A clock goes tick-a-tock. A frog sits on the log.
2) cat — fat, black; nice — mice, lion; my — fly, mice; me — we, he; big — witch, fish; frog — dog, hot; tell — spell, help; jump — run, hunt; music — cute, use; no — go, home; take — name, lake.
5-s84.answer: рифмы: pig/big, cat/black, hen/red; пары по звуку: cat/fat, nice/mice, frog/dog, no/go, take/name

6-s84.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 6, с. 84. Составь текст о парке в Лапландии — письмо Санте.
steps: Dear Santa Claus, my name is Misha. I am nine. My favourite character is the Nutcracker. He is kind. He likes nuts. His friend is a girl, Mary. They like dancing. Love, Misha.
6-s84.answer: Dear Santa, my name is … My favourite character is … Love, …

1-s85.condition: Lessons 25–26, упр. 1, с. 85. 1) Впиши транскрипционные знаки в имена эльфов; 2) прослушай и проверь.
steps: Bill /bɪl/, Harry /ˈhærɪ/, Charley /ˈtʃɑːlɪ/, Roger /ˈrɒdʒə/, Willy /ˈwɪlɪ/, Mary /ˈmeərɪ/, Edgar /ˈedgə/, Rosie /ˈrəʊzɪ/, Lucy /ˈluːsɪ/, Fred /fred/, Joe /dʒəʊ/, Howie /ˈhaʊɪ/, Ruth /ruːθ/, Ted /ted/.
1-s85.answer: Bill, Harry, Charley, Roger, Willy, Mary, Edgar, Rosie, Lucy, Fred, Joe, Howie, Ruth, Ted

2-s85.condition: Lessons 25–26, упр. 2, с. 85. Выбери правильные предложения и узнай имя вожака оленей Санты.
steps: Из букв правильных предложений получается имя Rudolph.

3-s86.condition: Lessons 25–26, упр. 3, с. 86. 1) Игра «Волшебное письмо Санте»; 2) заполни пропуски в письме.
steps: Dear Santa, my name is Masha. I am 8. I like painting. I am good at tennis. My favourite colour is green. My favourite animal is a rabbit. I have a cat. Love, Masha.
3-s86.answer: Masha, 8, painting, tennis, green, rabbit, a cat

4-s88.condition: Lessons 25–26, упр. 4, с. 88. Составь рассказ про кота Тома и проверь по записи.
steps: Tom is a cat. Tom is a big cat. He is joyful and merry. Tom likes eating mice. He likes singing «Mew-mew».
4-s88.answer: Tom is a big cat. He is joyful and merry. He likes eating mice.

1-s88.condition: Lesson 27, упр. 1, с. 88. 1) Назови символы Рождества; 2) впиши буквы во флажки и узнай название праздника.
steps: 1) Christmas tree, Santa Claus, presents, stocking, candle, star, elves, reindeer.
2) Christmas.

2-s88.condition: Lesson 27, упр. 2, с. 88. 1) Назови символы Нового года в России; 2) выпиши буквы и узнай название праздника.
steps: 1) Дед Мороз, Снегурочка, ёлка, подарки, снежинки.
2) New Year.

3-s88.condition: Lesson 27, упр. 3, с. 88. Допиши открытки и сделай к ним рисунки.
steps: Dear (имя), Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Love, (своё имя). Рисуем ёлку и Санту.
3-s88.answer: Dear …, Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Love, …

4-s88-2.condition: Lesson 27, упр. 4, с. 88. Расскажи историю про кота Тома, который любит смотреть телевизор.
steps: Tom, the TV cat. Tom is a big cat. He is red and white. He is funny. Tom likes eating mice. He helps his master. He likes singing «Mew-mew!».
4-s88-2.answer: Tom is a big red and white cat. He is funny. He likes eating mice and singing.
